senses.gloss: f. (v. Löw Pfl. p. 209) coriander (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Coriandrum).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 1:2">Kil. I, 2</cite> <he>כ׳ וכוּסְבַּר שדה וכ׳</he> (garden) coriander and field (wild) coriander … are not heterogeneous plants.
